title: Seedan
desc: Mano is in love with Maha, a maid, in his grandmother's house, but lacks the courage to confess to his mother. After his marriage is fixed, a distraught Maha vents her anger in Lord Murugan's temple.

title: Tirumurugan
desc: The son of a billionaire decides to leave his luxurious life behind by switching lives with his lookalike, who is a corporate employee, to experience the lifestyle that they both want to live.

title: Oh My Dog
desc: Arjun, a young boy, rescues a blind puppy. As the two develop a bond over time, he trains the dog for a competition with the help of his family.

title: Sokkali Mainor
desc: A widow decides to seek the help of her husband's spirit when she sees the marital life of her son shattering in front of her.

title: Thandatti
desc: Subramani, almost retired, goes on a hunt to find her missing grandmother. However, the search creates more trouble for Subramani than she expected.

title: Raja Kaiya Vacha
desc: Raja pretends to be a cop in order to impress the woman he loves, and she dumps him on learning the truth. When they meet again, he has a good job, but there is someone else who is in love with him.

title: Puthiyathor Ulagam Seivom
desc: Three students attempt to eliminate corrupt practices from society. Later, one of them seeks help from a local criminal to teach his father a lesson after learning he accepts bribes.

title: Singam Pettai - Dochai
desc: Conman Chandu stumbles upon a large sum of money that can solve all his problems. However, this places him in the crosshairs of a corrupt policeman and a fearsome crime boss.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Yaaro Ival
desc: Kalyan, a blind chef, regains his sight to uncover the truth behind Vennela's sudden disappearance, leading to unexpected twists and shocking revelations.

title: Irugapatru
desc: A marriage counsellor and her partner, along with two other couples, navigate the trials and tribulations of a love relationship.

title: Raame Aandalum Raavane Aandalum
desc: An impoverished rural couple look for their prized bulls, which have gone missing. However, they receive little help from a community that is apathetic to their plight.

title: Maaran
desc: Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.

title: Kadhale Kadhale
desc: Hari, a happy-go-lucky DJ, is not a stranger to rejection. But when he meets the beautiful Sailaja, he goes out of his way to make sure she reciprocates his feelings.

title: Saakini Daakini
desc: Two police trainees set out on a dangerous mission in order to investigate the kidnapping of a girl from a nightclub when they fail to get the police's help.

title: Nadungaadhey Illathil Pei
desc: A man poses as a tantric to earn money for his love interest's orphanage. However, things take a turn when a ghost begins to follow him after he pretends to perform an exorcism.
